Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, mild anisocytosis, and mildly elevated creatinine. Glucose is slightly low. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible infection or inflammatory process, and impaired renal function. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
